newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Posteel seeks 288 tonnes titanium sponge.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Posteel seeks 288 tonnes titanium sponge.

text.p: South Korea's Posco Steel Service and Sales Co Ltd (Posteel) is seeking to buy 288 tonnes of titanium sponge and 102 tonnes of low-carbon ferro-manganese, a company official said on Wednesday.
Posteel, an affiliate of steelmaker POSCO, will invite tenders to buy the metals by 11:00 am (0200 GMT) on April 23, the official said.
Arrival for 162 tonnes of titanium sponge was scheduled in June and another 126 tonnes in August.
Arrival for 68 tonnes of ferro-manganese was set in May and 34 tonnes in June.
The arrival port was slated for the southeastern city of Pusan, the official said.
But he said Posteel would pass on the tenders if offer prices were higher than expected. In that case, the company would re-tender on April 30.
